sources.title: Reichle et al 2010 — Eye Movements During Mindless Reading
Schooler et al 2011 — Meta-awareness and perceptual decoupling
Lindsay et al — Brief mindfulness and acceptance trial
Inspire3 public affiliate portal: not account-specific approval
Final Vestige Puységur historic source archive

claims.statement: Eye movements can continue during mindless reading with reduced linguistic modulation
claims.caveat: Experimental reading context, not diagnosis

claims.statement: Mind-wandering may involve perceptual decoupling and delayed meta-awareness
claims.caveat: Conceptual framework, not universal causal proof

claims.statement: A particular smartphone experience-sampling cohort reported off-task thought at 46.9% of sampled moments
claims.caveat: Not a population-wide constant

claims.statement: Mind-wandering causes unhappiness in all people
claims.caveat: Observational associations cannot settle all directions of causality

claims.statement: 147 young adults randomized to 4 conditions for brief 3-day training
claims.caveat: Not the Zen12 product or general long-term clinical endpoint

claims.statement: Monitoring-plus-acceptance group had lower lab-task mind-wandering than monitoring only
claims.caveat: Experimental instructions and SART outcome; no audio-product inference

claims.statement: Zen12 Premium offers 12 levels and 48 MP3s
claims.caveat: No independently verified fulfillment or file audit

claims.statement: Zen12 includes four audio listening styles
claims.caveat: Exact audio content not independently listened to or verified

claims.statement: Zen12 advertises a one-year guarantee
claims.caveat: Full terms and actual refund performance not verified

claims.statement: Zen12 offers the benefits of one hour of advanced meditation in 12 minutes
claims.caveat: No product-specific substantiation reviewed

claims.statement: Zen12 causes instant anxiety relief
claims.caveat: Seller wording does not establish clinical efficacy

claims.statement: Zen12 improves concentration or creativity versus a free timer
claims.caveat: No verified head-to-head Zen12 study

claims.statement: Zen12 Premium price is a fixed and verified checkout total
claims.caveat: Public promotional display fluctuated in prior snapshots; taxes/checkout unknown

claims.statement: Publisher-specific Inspire3 affiliate approval has been received
claims.caveat: Public sign-up portal is not an approval letter

claims.statement: Inspire3 permitted channels include email, social, site and disclosures under named FV agreement
claims.caveat: Private signed terms absent

claims.statement: Issued Final Vestige tracking URL and attribution windows have been verified
claims.caveat: No issued earning link or channel rules

claims.statement: A prominent near-control disclosure is required upon commercial activation
claims.caveat: Exact layout must undergo final review on every device

claims.statement: Health-related efficacy claims require competent and reliable relevant evidence
claims.caveat: Product-specific application; avoid implied guarantees

claims.statement: The public Focus Fieldbook provides an existing free route
claims.caveat: An accessible landing page is not authoritative confirmed lead

claims.statement: Published Puységur and Mesmerism content provides historical context
claims.caveat: Historical reporting does not prove clinical hypnosis claims

claims.statement: Affiliate outbound click proves a commission or sale
claims.caveat: Require independent merchant settlement and refunds

claims.statement: Net revenue per 1000 qualified sessions is computable from currently verified data
claims.caveat: No authenticated cohort denominator or settled merchant receipts

gates.requirement: Partner dashboard or signed correspondence naming Final Vestige publisher acceptance
Partner channel-specific website, social and email permissions; no assumption from public affiliate page
Issued, unmodified merchant earning URL, allowed redirect/UTM rules, expiration and attribution window
Current plan-specific checkout price, eligibility, taxes/fees, fulfillment/refund terms verified against final checkout and contract
Independent product-matched competent evidence if any objective cognitive/health claims are proposed; otherwise omit
Authenticate rights-cleared, currently sellable FV-owned Mind Payhip SKU and purchase/refund terms before fallback
Grok/Praxxis TASK-008 reconcile posted immutable asset_id, platform URL, hook, channel, creative rights and destination
Jetpack-authoritative opt-in confirmation for cohort; do not duplicate existing Focus welcome or list
Merchant-confirmed settled paid orders or cleared affiliate commissions reconciled with refunds/chargebacks/fees
Consent-respecting aggregated human-session denominator linked only to approved campaign asset_id/utm, spam filtered
Founder production approval + Site QA actual-browser a11y/UX + CSP/performance review + publisher legal copy
Original rights-cleared 42-second video rendered and audited for captions/transcript/poster, opt-in/no-autoplay, mobile performance

landing_visit.definition: aggregate qualified human session with consent and canonical asset_id/utm_campaign; no IP/device fingerprint

relevant_cta_click.definition: internal click to existing Focus or evidence guide, not a sale

lead_confirmed.definition: Jetpack authoritative opt-in from existing list, where consent and lawful aggregate reporting permit

merchant_outbound_click.definition: future gated disclosed earning-link activation, never commission or purchase

paid_order_confirmed.definition: merchant-authoritative unique paid transaction id counted only once; never use client-side purchase pixel as evidence

affiliate_commission_cleared.definition: independent partner confirmed cleared and attributable commission only

refund_fee_reconciliation.definition: merchant reported returns, fee offsets, chargebacks and cancellation adjustments

revenue_formula: realized_net_revenue = settled_FV_owned_cash_receipts + cleared_affiliate_commissions - refunds - chargebacks - processor_fees - attributable_merchant_fees; KPI = 1000 * realized_net_revenue / qualified_human_sessions (only where denominator>0 and authoritative inputs exist)
reason_not_computable: Authoritative cleared revenue, refunds, fees and qualified-human denominator missing; NULL, never 0
